physicalEvidence.status: Prior CMU collaborative learned-perception-to-real-flight-control evidence, physical 20
physicalEvidence.summary: Full 2025 ViSafe deploys learned AirTrack aircraft detection/tracking into an onboard control-barrier-function pipeline that sends yaw-rate navigation commands to a real Aurelia X6 autopilot. Physical trials at two US outdoor sites used multirotor and VTOL intruders; simulation is evaluated separately. This is prior CMU collaborative hardware, not current BYU apparatus. The paper acknowledges below-horizon detection failures and conditional perception assumptions; no unconditional safety guarantee is inferred. The September 2026 BYU coastal VLM study analyzes recorded WAM-V imagery and does not establish learned vessel control.
